subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the following figure. Find the number on the face opposite to 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/179f23e9428fa1dfa51118533bb759583b543a442479a65b844c25d528fbf131.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 4 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 2, 3, 6, and 5 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e., 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3fba26bcc61feaecc2dabba5135469ef42905a8f6eadbf55e076015abf3244c.png] 

Opposite pairs:

2 → 5

3 → 6

4 → 1

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "5".

Hence, the correct answer is "5".
